steps.name: editable install with the development tools (needs network)
steps.cmd: {python} -c "import subprocess, sys, pathlib; exe = pathlib.Path('.venv') / ('Scripts' if sys.platform == 'win32' else 'bin') / 'python'; sys.exit(subprocess.call([str(exe), '-m', 'pip', 'install', '-e', '.[dev]']))"

steps.name: tests
